people.name: Devin Ebanks
people.extract: Devin Maurice Ebanks is an American professional basketball player for Manama Club of the Bahraini Premier League. He was selected 43rd overall by the Los Angeles Lakers in the 2010 NBA draft, after playing college basketball for two seasons at West Virginia University.
highlights: Professional basketball player for Manama Club.
Selected 43rd by Los Angeles Lakers in 2010 NBA draft.
Played college basketball for West Virginia University.

people.name: Charlie Daniels
people.extract: Charles Edward Daniels was an American singer, songwriter, and musician. His music fused rock, country, blues and jazz and was a pioneering contribution to Southern rock and progressive country. He was best known for his number-one country hit "The Devil Went Down to Georgia". Much of his output, including all but one of his eight Billboard Hot 100 charting singles, was credited to the Charlie Daniels Band.
highlights: Best known for hit 'The Devil Went Down to Georgia'.
Pioneering contribution to Southern rock and progressive country.
